appDescription: An app that records running courses while driving and keeps notes about the road on the course map.

function.name: ADD_COURSE_MEMO
function.description: Adds a note about the road the user is driving on to the running course being recorded, at the place where the user started speaking.

memo.description: The note to keep, as the user said it.

title.description: A label of a few words that sums up the note, shown on the course map.
